preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The integers M and N must be between 0 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(string) <= 10**6 and all(c in 'RK' for c in string)
preconditions.description: The length of the string must not exceed 10^6 and it must consist only of characters 'R' and 'K'.

postconditions.description: The output must be two space-separated integers representing the count of substrings with exactly M 'R's and N 'K's.
